Name: Minerva's Bigger Farmhouses
Author: minervamaga
TagLine: Some new bigger farmhouse maps for your enjoyment
Description:
DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS MOD FROM ANYWHERE EXCEPT NEXUSMODS, MODDROP, OR MY GITHUB
Other websites are stealing mods from Nexus and uploading them without permission, while earning money on each mod they steal.  My mods are always found on the three sites listed above and no where else.

If you find you are constantly running out of space in your farmhouse thanks to Custom Furniture and Custom Farming Redux, you might have looked for some bigger farmhouse maps.  I couldn't find one that worked perfectly for what I wanted, so I decided to make some instead!

NOTE: When updating to 1.0.1+, please remove all items from your attic first!  When updating to 1.2.1+, please delete the folder and install a clean version!

All farmhouses now have a basement and an attic, as well as working bathrooms.  The bathrooms feature tubs with regenerative properties, just like the mountain bathhouse.  They also have mirrors that function as character customization screens, for those who don't use Kisekae, but don't want to wait until the vanilla option opens up.  For those who do use Kisekae, the dressers should show up as normal.  The kitchen and fridge in the base farmhouse also both function as normal, allowing you to cook from the start of the game.

I've added child bed configuration options as a request and am happy to make more variants if anyone is interested.  This mod also uses Mabel's Farmhouse Redone to allow decoration of the walls and changing the wallpaper/flooring for rooms.  A few rooms still have locked flooring and wallpaper, due to their layouts.

This mod requires [Content Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915) to work, as well as [Farmhouse Redone](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3731)﻿ (optional if you just want the CP version).

WORKS WITH SDV 1.4!

Install

1.  [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io/).

2.  [Install Content Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915) and [Farmhouse Redone](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3731)﻿.

3.  Download this mod and unzip it, then copy  the '[FR] Minerva's Bigger Farmhouses' folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.

4.  Run the game once to generate the config file, options are listed below.

5.  Run the game using SMAPI, you're done!
Config Options

*   "ApplyToCabins": Allows true/false.  When set to true, affects all cabins.

*   "Farmhouse2Beds"

*   "Farmhouse2MarriageBeds"

*   "CabinUpgrade2Beds"

*   "CabinUpgrade2MarriageBeds"

*   All four fields use the same options, which are "Default, Crib+1Bed, CribOnly, NoBeds".  Defaults to "NoBeds" for non-marriage maps, "Default" after marriage, which is crib + 2 beds.
